title: Antarctica Basics
summary: Learn why Antarctica matters for climate, oceans and global science.
content: Antarctica stores most of Earth's fresh water as ice. Its ice sheets, ocean circulation and ecosystems help scientists understand climate change and sea-level rise.

title: Indian Polar Stations
summary: Explore Maitri, Bharati and the legacy of Dakshin Gangotri.
content: India operates polar stations to support long-term scientific monitoring. Maitri and Bharati help researchers study weather, geology, biology and the Southern Ocean.
